3.name: Star Map
3.notes:
You've created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. It is a Tiny object, and you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells. You determine its form by rolling on the Star Map table or by choosing one.

While holding the map, you have the Guidance and Guiding Bolt spells prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot. You can cast it this way a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to magically create a replacement. This ceremony can be performed during a Short or Long Rest, and it destroys the previous map.

Star Map
1d6	Map Form
1	A scroll bearing depictions of constellations
2	A stone tablet with fine holes drilled through it
3	An owlbear hide tooled with stellar symbols
4	A collection of maps bound in an ebony cover
5	A crystal engraved with starry patterns
6	A glass disk etched with constellations

3.name: Starry Form
3.notes:
As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form instead of transforming.

While in this form, you retain your game statistics, but your body becomes luminous with star-like joints connected by glowing lines. You shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. The form lasts for 10 minutes or until you dismiss it, have the Incapacitated condition, or use this feature again.

Whenever you assume this form, choose one constellation; you gain benefits while it lasts:

Archer. As a Bonus Action when you activate this form and on subsequent turns, you can make a ranged spell attack at a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, it deals Radiant damage equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

Chalice. Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores Hit Points, you or a creature of your choice within 30 feet regains additional HP equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

Dragon. When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check, or a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, treat rolls of 9 or lower as a 10.

6.name: Cosmic Omen
6.notes:
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, consult your Star Map for omens and roll a die. Until your next Long Rest, you gain a special Reaction based on the roll:

Weal (even). When a creature within 30 feet is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and add the result to the total.

Woe (odd). When a creature within 30 feet is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and subtract the result from the total.

You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

10.name: Twinkling Constellations
10.notes:
Your Starry Form constellations improve. The 1d8 of Archer and Chalice becomes 2d8. While the Dragon is active, you gain a Fly Speed of 20 feet and can hover.

Additionally, at the start of each turn while in Starry Form, you can change which constellation is active.

14.name: Full of Stars
14.notes: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
